title: fix(console): a data-page filter chip on a select field shows the option label
body:
Fixes #37259
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在仪表盘图表「在列表中打开」后的数据列表页，选择型字段的筛选标签显示选项的显示名（如「产品类别 = 软件」），不再显示内部存储值（「software」）。
- 为什么做：仪表盘下钻到列表是用户从图表查看明细记录的常规路径，标签显示内部代码会让用户看不懂当前筛选条件，中文界面下还会夹杂英文。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是筛选标签上的文字显示不对，列表本身的筛选结果不受影响；合并后可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On the bare data page (`/:objectName/data?filter[...]`, ADR-0055), the screen a dashboard drill's "Open in list" lands on, a URL filter chip on a field that declares `options` drew the stored option value (`Category = software`) instead of its label (`软件` in zh-CN).

- `groupFilterChips` (`drillUrlFilters.ts`) takes an optional `comparandText(field, value)` callback and draws every whole-value comparand through it: equality (`= X`), does-not-equal (`[ne]`) and each member of a membership list (`[in]`, `[nin]`). The default is `String(value)`, so every existing caller and test reads as before. Range bounds and text-operator fragments (`contains`, `starts_with`, ...) stay verbatim: a fragment names no option.
- `ObjectDataPage` passes a labeller that reuses the grid cell's path: `translateOptions(objectDef.name, field, options)` from `useObjectLabel` (the call `generateColumns` makes for the grid), then the option whose value equals the comparand, drawn with `optionDisplayLabel` from `@object-ui/core` (what `TextCellRenderer` draws). A comparand that matches no declared option stays raw, so a stale or hand-edited address still shows what it filters by.
- The chips are computed per render instead of in a `useMemo`, the same as the field half's `fieldLabel`, so both halves of a chip read the translation catalogue at the same moment (an app bundle that loads after the first render reaches the chip too).

Responsibility:
- Whose code: the platform's own console data surface (`@object-ui/app-shell` URL filter chips).
- Existing platform path: the grid cell's option label (`translateOptions` over the field's declared `options`).
- Who reaches it: every user who opens a chart grouped by a select field in a list through the dashboard drill's 「在列表中打开」.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx`, the `groupFilterChips(urlFilters, ...)` labeller: the field lookup, the exact-value match and the raw fallback.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/drillUrlFilters.ts`, `groupFilterChips`: which operators go through `comparandText` (`WHOLE_VALUE_OP_WORDS` plus equality) and which stay raw.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx`, the `objectstack#37259` describe.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx` from the repo root; expect 17 passed, with the seven `objectstack#37259` cases among them.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing chip harness `ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx` (real page, real `I18nProvider`, an app bundle carrying `fieldOptions.showcase_invoice.category.software = 软件`):

| Case | On main (`1b91538bb2`) | On this head |
|---|---|---|
| equality chip, zh-Hans: `= 软件` | red (`= software`) | green |
| equality chip, en: `= Software` | red (`= software`) | green |
| membership `[in]`, zh-Hans: `属于 软件, 硬件` | red (`属于 software, hardware`) | green |
| negation `[ne]`, zh-Hans: `不等于 软件` | red (`不等于 software`) | green |
| CONTROL unknown comparand stays raw: `= legacy_code` | green | green |
| CONTROL text operator keeps its fragment: `包含 software` | green | green |
| CONTROL field without options keeps today's text: `= software` | green | green |

The three controls are green on both sides by design: they pin what must not change.

The harness also gains a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test whose source reaches that dynamic import.

- Red on main: `ObjectDataPage.tsx` and `drillUrlFilters.ts` restored from `1b91538bb2` (tree only), harness at HEAD: `Tests 4 failed | 13 passed (17)`; the four failures are the four label cases above (`expected '= software' to be '= 软件'`, and so on). Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: `git diff HEAD` empty, both blobs equal to HEAD.
- Ablation, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, anchor `return option ? optionDisplayLabel(option) : raw;` replaced by `return raw;`: mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `1bc2af587dc6` to `95bff3d412e5`), `Tests 4 failed | 13 passed (17)`, the same four cases; restored, blob after restore `1bc2af587dc6` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported by relative path from `src/`, not through a package `exports`, so no `dist/` preflight applies.

## Acceptance notes

- The match is exact on the stored value (`String(option.value) === comparand`). The grid's `findDeclaredOption` adds a case-insensitive fallback for mixed-case seed data; the chip does not, because the comparand is the filter the server applies, and a label for a value that only matches case-insensitively could name an option the filter did not select.
- The labeller applies to any field that declares a non-empty `options` list, which is the same test the grid's `TextCellRenderer` uses, not only to `select` / `multiselect` / `radio`.
- Out of scope, noted only: a boolean comparand still reads `= true` / `= false`, and a lookup comparand still reads as the referenced record's id, not its name.
- Browser repro through the drill: NOT MEASURED. The shared verification lock was held by another run for about 100 minutes while this change waited, and booting a backend plus the Console would have added a second heavy load on that box. The page-level pins render the real `ObjectDataPage` under real packs instead.
